annotations.text: Increment is addition by one, with a 16-bit zero as the second operand.
A ripple-carry 16-bit adder. The least-significant full adder receives CIN.
Two half adders plus OR combine the carry paths.
SUM is XOR; CARRY is AND.
XOR = (A OR B) AND NOT(A AND B), expressed using the NAND-derived parts.
OR follows from De Morgan: NOT(NOT A NAND NOT B).
NOT is NAND with the same signal connected to both inputs.
The primitive used as the construction starting point for the Nand2Tetris hardware track.
